equip_leveling.title: Equip Leveling
equip_leveling.config.title: Equip Leveling Settings
equip_leveling.config.category.general.d: The two big sliders control the whole mod. Open "Advanced options" to fine-tune everything else.
equip_leveling.config.category.xp_leveli: Every XP multiplier in one place: global gain, per-source multipliers, base XP per category, and max enchantment slots.
equip_leveling.config.category.enchantin: What the enchanting table offers when your item is ready: how often each reward appears, the price to reroll, the material upgrade order, and how many enchantment slots each item can hold.
equip_leveling.config.sub.requirements.d: How much total XP each item needs before it can level up. Bigger number = slower leveling.
equip_leveling.config.sub.source_multipl: Fine-tune how much XP you earn from each activity. These stack with the global XP gain multiplier above. Set to 0 to disable XP from that source entirely.
equip_leveling.config.sub.weights.desc: These numbers decide how likely each reward is at the enchanting table. Higher number = that reward shows up more often.
equip_leveling.config.sub.reroll.desc: How many XP levels it costs to roll three new offers at the enchanting table. The price goes up as you fill more enchantment slots.
equip_leveling.config.sub.material_ladde: The order materials upgrade through when you get a legendary upgrade. Grouped by mining level.
equip_leveling.config.sub.max_slots.desc: How many enchantment slots each item can have. Raise it up to 8 if you use enchantment mods.
equip_leveling.config.level_req_growth.t: How much more XP each level needs compared to the previous one. Higher = steeper leveling curve. Try 1.2 for normal, 2.0 for hard.
equip_leveling.config.global_gain.toolti: Multiplies ALL XP from every source. 1.0 = normal speed. 0.5 = half speed. 2.0 = double speed.
equip_leveling.config.xp_threshold: Show XP gains above this number
equip_leveling.config.xp_threshold.toolt: Only XP gains at or above this number show a floating message. Set to 0 to show everything.
equip_leveling.config.durability_restore: How much of the item's missing durability is repaired every time it levels up.
equip_leveling.config.repair_kit_restore: Flat durability restored by a regular Repair Kit when combined with an item in a crafting grid.
equip_leveling.config.diamond_repair_kit: Percentage of max durability restored by a Diamond Repair Kit when combined with an item in a crafting grid.
equip_leveling.config.keep_on_death.tool: When on, leveled equipment stays in your inventory when you die. Other items still drop.
equip_leveling.config.broken_mechanic.to: When an item reaches zero durability it becomes [BROKEN] and stops working instead of disappearing. Repair it at an anvil.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_base.tooltip: XP levels charged to repair an item at an anvil, before its level is added.
equip_leveling.config.anvil_per_level.to: Extra XP levels added to the anvil price for every level the item has.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.mob.to: XP multiplier for killing hostile mobs. Uses a danger formula based on health, attack damage, and armor.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.livest: XP multiplier for killing passive farm animals (cows, pigs, sheep, chickens). Flat XP per kill.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.mining: XP multiplier for breaking ores and stone with a pickaxe. Scales with ore rarity and mining level.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.farmin: XP multiplier for harvesting mature crops with a hoe. Scales with food value and growth time.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.wood.t: XP multiplier for chopping logs and stems with an axe. Flat XP per log.
equip_leveling.config.source_mult.fishin: XP multiplier for catching fish with a fishing rod.
equip_leveling.config.base_xp.tooltip: Total XP needed for a %s to reach its first level-up.
equip_leveling.config.upgrade_weight.too: How likely an offer upgrades an enchantment you already have.
equip_leveling.config.new_slot_weight.to: How likely an offer adds a brand new enchantment to an empty slot.
equip_leveling.config.legendary_chance.t: Chance per enchanting visit that one offer is a material upgrade instead of an enchantment.
equip_leveling.config.reroll_cost.toolti: XP levels spent to reroll when %d standard slots are filled.
equip_leveling.config.material_ladder.to: Opens a dedicated editor where you can group materials by mining level and reorder them.
equip_leveling.config.max_slots.tooltip: Maximum enchantment slots a %s can hold. Raise it to 8 for modded enchantments.
